formula.derivative: Smooth-chain sensitivity w*I*(1-I) on supported samples; actual PyTorch autograd sensitivity also measured. Quantized forward map has plateaus, so smooth derivative is not a finite-change guarantee.
formula.fp32_add: Same AMP features and AMP decoder delta; promote a0 and delta before addition/sigmoid, retain original weights and mask.
formula.fp32_branch: Private appearance bank and decoder under autocast disabled; cached old a0/geo/direction promoted, FP32 addition and sigmoid. Intrinsically FP16 frozen tcnn outputs remain as implemented.
formula.delta_bounds: No explicit bound/clamp on decoder correction. High-order cap constrains intermediate feature residuals, not delta logits.
formula.own_zero_rule: Every learned J is compared with its same-path delta=0 output; zero-path offsets are reported separately.

scope: Preselected TRAIN fit/probe pool only; no optimization in numerical paths

amp.gradient_scope: Backward only; first fixed128-ray fit minibatch, original objective; no optimizer step

definitions.quantiles: absolute magnitude; signed_mean separate; empty strata have null statistics
definitions.FP: not GT_return and original final mask
definitions.saturation: I<=.01 or I>=.99; exact endpoints separately counted
definitions.numerical_comparison: Read-only; compare each path with its own zero output, never use precision-only offsets as learned gains
